ejs.reason: ejs 2 renders the report of webpack-bundle-analyzer in the Auspice build command, which the project never runs

maplibre-gl.reason: The map of Auspice, which the web app does not bundle

postcss.reason: postcss 7 runs only in css-loader of the Auspice build command, which the project never runs; the postcss 8 of Vite is newer than every affected range

postcss-selector-parser.reason: postcss-selector-parser 6 runs only in css-loader of the Auspice build command, which the project never runs

serialize-javascript.reason: serialize-javascript 2 runs only in compression-webpack-plugin of the Auspice build command, which the project never runs

sprintf-js.reason: argparse 1 loads sprintf-js only in the command lines of Auspice and js-yaml 3, which the project never runs; every release up to the latest, 1.1.3, is affected

uuid.reason: uuid 3 runs only in webpack-log of the Auspice development server, which the project never runs; react-tooltip uses uuid 11.1.1 through an override

webpack-dev-middleware.reason: The Auspice development server, which the project never runs

xlsx.reason: The spreadsheet export of Auspice, which the web app does not bundle; npm has no fixed release
